newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says Australia outlook favourable.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says Australia outlook favourable.

text.p: Australia's economic outlook remains favourable, Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday in releasing the nation's mid-year budget review.
"The economic outlook for Australia remains favourable," Costello said. Costello also said the forecast for business investment growth has been revised to 17 percent from the original 14 percent.
Costello said that while the GDP growth forecast remained at 3.5 percent, the composition of growth had changed.
"...The composition of the growth will be, we expect, different. Business investment will be stronger and private consumption has eased," Costello said.
